title: Jumping Jack Flash
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
1. I was born in crossfire hurricane,
and I howled at my mama in the driving rain.

[bridge]
2. I was raised by toothless, bearded hag,
I was schooled with strap right across my back.

[bridge]
3. I was drowned, I was washed up and left for dead,
I fell down to my feet and I saw they bled.
I frowned at the crumbs of crust of bread
I was crowned with spike right thru my head.

[bridge]
Jumping Jack Flash, it`s gas ....... (rep. and fade)
